name: Gungans + Tarpals Omi
description:
Gungans are a fantastic TB squad that allows you to take advantage of their Shield Generator, which the AI seems to have a hard time dealing with.
The team is weak to swarm attacks, and if the Generator dies, the team falls apart fast.
notes: Can hide behind the Shield Generator
